name: Product Hunt
notes: Flagship tech launch surface; prepare screenshots and a crisp one-liner.

name: BetaList
notes: Strong for pre-launch products with a landing page.

name: Hacker News
notes: Show HN works when the product and title earn it.

name: Indie Hackers
notes: Better for founder narrative than one-click listings.

name: AlternativeTo
notes: Frame the product as an alternative to known tools.

name: SaaSHub
notes: Straightforward SaaS catalog listing.

name: StartupStash
notes: Founder-oriented tools catalog.

name: Slant
notes: Comparison-style community recommendations.

name: G2
notes: Strict review culture; listing is not instant authority.

name: Capterra
notes: Software directory and reviews for SaaS buyers.

name: GetApp
notes: Gartner Digital Markets family; similar buyer intent to Capterra.

name: Toolify
notes: Useful when the product is clearly AI-positioned.

name: There's An AI For That
notes: Large AI discovery catalog.

name: Futurepedia
notes: Needs a clear category and positioning.

name: Crunchbase
notes: Brand and investor discoverability; not a classic SEO directory.

name: 开源中国
notes: Strong for open-source and developer tools.

name: 掘金
notes: Content-led discovery; earn the link in the piece.

name: V2EX
notes: Community norms matter; avoid spammy self-promo.

name: 小众软件
notes: Pitch quality tools; editorial acceptance is selective.

name: SegmentFault
notes: Developer Q&A and writing surface.
